content: nodemailer latest is 9.0.3 per npm registry. Standard self-hosted pattern: createTransport({host, port, secure, auth:{user,pass}}) populated from ENV vars (SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_SECURE, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM), provider-neutral (works with any SMTP relay: Postfix, Mailgun SMTP, SES SMTP, etc.).
